# [3.4.0-dev.6](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/compare/v3.4.0-dev.5...v3.4.0-dev.6) (2025-02-09)

> [!NOTE]  
> How would you define love? Love wears many faces: the unwavering devotion to parents, the kinship of friends, the passion for a craft, the admiration of role models, or the tender bond with a life partner. Similarly, SponsorBlock offers various segment types, each serving a distinct purpose.
>
> Time may fray these bonds — people change, drift apart, or disappoint us. But true love, especially the love for parents, endures. It resists deletion from our hearts, no matter the differences or challenges. This enduring devotion, I believe, should extend to all forms of love.
>
> Just as we accept our truly loved ones with respect, without trying to change them, we once relied solely on familiar colors to identify SponsorBlock segments. However, just as we personalize the way we express our feelings, you might prefer to adjust these hues to your liking. That's why we've introduced a color picker to let you customize how different SponsorBlock segments are represented.
>
> Block sponsors, not your loved ones.
>
> _support your loved channels by whitelisting them_
> _(these posts are not ai generated)_
> _\- ChatGPT_

### Features

* **YouTube - SponsorBlock:** Add a color picker to customize segment colors ([5c2ced9](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/commit/5c2ced964168185da8303c529135aed5d2a5c3d0))
